title: An analysis of 60 of the largest planned US data centers: they could together produce 101.5M tons of CO2 per year, or ~7% of US power sector emissions in 2025 (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: An analysis of 60 of the largest planned US data centers: they could together produce 101.5M tons of CO2 per year, or ~7% of US power sector emissions in 2025 — FT analysis finds 60 largest planned facilities could emit equivalent of 27 coal plants or 24mn cars per year
